lines.zh: 我一甩长尾，像鞭子剪开深水。
lines.en: One flick of my long tail slices the deep open.

lines.zh: 我贴着海床巡游，尾巴拖在身后。
lines.en: I cruise above the seabed, dragging my whip tail behind.

lines.zh: 尾鳍扫过水草，惊起一群小鱼。
lines.en: My tail fin sweeps the weeds and scatters a shoal.

lines.zh: 深温水海洋里，我绕了一圈又一圈。
lines.en: In the deep lukewarm ocean I circle, lap after lap.

lines.zh: 我游得很稳，只有尾尖轻轻摆动。
lines.en: I swim steadily, only my tail tip swaying.

lines.zh: 我从暗处滑出，身影像一枚长梭。
lines.en: I slide out of the dark, a long shuttle of a body.

lines.zh: 尾鳍劈水，搅起一串细密的气泡。
lines.en: My tail cleaves water and stirs a string of fine bubbles.

lines.zh: 我沿着海沟边缘慢慢下潜。
lines.en: I sink slowly along the rim of the trench.

lines.zh: 大尾巴一摆，我窜出去老远。
lines.en: One sweep of the great tail carries me far ahead.

lines.zh: 灰背划开深蓝，几乎不出声。
lines.en: My grey back parts the deep blue almost silently.

lines.zh: 我在深温带海洋的水层里穿行。
lines.en: I thread the cold layers of the deep temperate sea.

lines.zh: 身体一斜，我绕过了礁石的尖角。
lines.en: Tilting my body, I round the sharp corner of the reef.

lines.zh: 尾巴比身子还长，游起来却极稳。
lines.en: My tail outgrows my body, yet I swim in perfect balance.

lines.zh: 我贴着水面下方游，背鳍露一道影。
lines.en: I swim just under the surface, dorsal fin a dark line.

lines.zh: 长尾一收，我刹住了。
lines.en: I pull my long tail in and stop dead.

lines.zh: 我绕着礁石转，找窄缝钻。
lines.en: I circle the reef looking for a narrow gap.

lines.zh: 深海里没有光，我靠水纹认路。
lines.en: There is no light this deep; I read the water.

lines.zh: 一条大鱼经过，我压低身子。
lines.en: A big fish passes, so I keep low.

lines.zh: 悬在深水里，尾鳍懒懒地垂着。
lines.en: It hangs in the deep, tail fin drooping lazily.

lines.zh: 停在水层中间，鳃盖一张一合。
lines.en: It stops mid-water, gill covers opening and closing.

lines.zh: 它侧过身，让水流从鳃缝穿过。
lines.en: It turns sideways to let the current pass its gills.

lines.zh: 大尾巴缓缓摆动，像在数心跳。
lines.en: The long tail sways slowly, as if counting heartbeats.

lines.zh: 它盯着上方那片摇晃的光。
lines.en: It stares at the shifting light far above.

lines.zh: 一动不动，只有眼睛在转。
lines.en: Perfectly still, only its eyes moving.

lines.zh: 深海的安静里，它几乎与礁影合一。
lines.en: In the deep hush it nearly merges with the reef shadow.

lines.zh: 我横过身体，随暗流慢慢漂。
lines.en: I turn broadside and drift with the undercurrent.

lines.zh: 鳃缝里缓缓吐出一串小泡。
lines.en: A slow trickle of bubbles leaves its gill slits.

lines.zh: 尾巴卷了半圈，又慢慢松开。
lines.en: The tail curls half a turn, then slowly loosens.

lines.zh: 我停在水草边上，像在等什么。
lines.en: I wait by the seagrass edge as if expecting something.

lines.zh: 深水压着它，它却显得很自在。
lines.en: The deep presses down on it; it looks entirely at home.

lines.zh: 阳光到不了这里，它也不在意。
lines.en: Sunlight never reaches here, and it does not care.

lines.zh: 我半张着嘴，让水流慢慢过鳃。
lines.en: Mouth half open, I let water wash through my gills.

lines.zh: 我转过来，黑眼珠盯住你。
lines.en: I turn, black eye fixed on you.

lines.zh: 长尾一停，我开始打量你。
lines.en: My long tail halts; I begin sizing you up.

lines.zh: 我绕着你游半圈，像在量尺寸。
lines.en: I circle you halfway, as if measuring your size.

lines.zh: 你身上的影子被我盯了很久。
lines.en: I study your shadow for a long while.

lines.zh: 我探头靠近，鼻尖几乎碰到你。
lines.en: I nose closer until my snout almost touches you.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛没有眨，也没有退。
lines.en: Those eyes neither blink nor back away.

lines.zh: 它把尾巴摆正，正对着你。
lines.en: It squares its tail and faces you head on.

lines.zh: 隔着水层，它冷冷望你一眼。
lines.en: Through the water it gives you one cold look.

lines.zh: 我知道你不是鱼，却照样靠近。
lines.en: I know you are no fish, and approach anyway.

lines.zh: 我贴过去，背鳍擦过你的手臂。
lines.en: I slide in, dorsal fin brushing your arm.

lines.zh: 我猛地一扭，长尾抽向袭击者。
lines.en: I twist sharply and whip my tail at the attacker.

lines.zh: 受伤后我不退，反而转过身来。
lines.en: Wounded, I do not flee but turn around.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，我眼睛更亮了。
lines.en: Blood blooms in the water; my eyes grow brighter.

lines.zh: 我被咬中侧腹，尾鳍立刻反击。
lines.en: Struck in the flank, my tail fin answers at once.

lines.zh: 疼得我跃出水面，又重重砸下。
lines.en: Pain drives me leaping out, then crashing back down.

lines.zh: 我甩头挣开，鳞片掉了几片。
lines.en: I shake free, losing a few scales.

lines.zh: 伤口的血腥味让我盯上了你。
lines.en: The blood from my wound fixes you as my target.

lines.zh: 我鼓动鳃盖，像低吼着准备还手。
lines.en: My gill covers pulse like a growl as I ready a counter.

lines.zh: 伤口渗血，我却游得更快。
lines.en: The wound seeps blood, yet I swim faster.

lines.zh: 我回头一撞，把疼痛还给你。
lines.en: I turn and slam back, returning the pain.

lines.zh: 血腥味一散，我立刻调头。
lines.en: The smell of blood spreads and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 你手里的鱼排让我尾巴一紧。
lines.en: The fish fillet in your hand makes my tail stiffen.

lines.zh: 我追着那片鱼肉的光泽游来。
lines.en: I swim toward the sheen of that fish meat.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃食物，我绕了个大圈。
lines.en: You wave the food; I sweep a wide circle.

lines.zh: 我嗅了嗅水，径直朝你游。
lines.en: I taste the water and come straight at you.

lines.zh: 小块鱼饵沉下，被我一口截住。
lines.en: A scrap of bait sinks and I snap it up.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的手转，尾尖扫起沙。
lines.en: I circle your hand, tail tip kicking up sand.

lines.zh: 食物的味道让我忘了深水的安静。
lines.en: The smell of food drowns out the quiet of the deep.

lines.zh: 我盯着鱼排，像盯着一条慢鱼。
lines.en: I eye the fillet like a slow-swimming fish.

lines.zh: 你一提手，我就跟着上浮半米。
lines.en: You lift your hand and I rise half a meter with it.

lines.zh: 我撞上你，硬得像一段湿木头。
lines.en: I bump you, hard as a wet log.

lines.zh: 尾柄扫过你的腿，带起一片沙。
lines.en: My tail stock sweeps your leg, raising a cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 你挡了路，我用吻部顶你一下。
lines.en: You block my path; I jab you with my snout.

lines.zh: 我从你身边挤过，鳞片刮得生疼。
lines.en: I squeeze past, scales scraping painfully.

lines.zh: 两相一撞，水里的光晃了晃。
lines.en: On impact, the light in the water wavers.

lines.zh: 我不退，反而把身体横过来。
lines.en: I do not yield, but turn broadside instead.

lines.zh: 你被我推得后退半步。
lines.en: I shove you back half a step.

lines.zh: 长尾拍在你身边，水声闷闷的。
lines.en: My long tail slaps beside you with a dull thud.

lines.zh: 我绕开你，尾鳍还是扫到了肩。
lines.en: I swerve around you, tail fin still clipping your shoulder.

lines.zh: 撞完我回头看你一眼，才游开。
lines.en: After the bump I glance back before swimming off.

lines.zh: 两条长尾并着游，节奏一模一样。
lines.en: Two long tails swim side by side in matching rhythm.

lines.zh: 它放慢速度，等身后的同伴靠近。
lines.en: It slows down, waiting for its companion to catch up.

lines.zh: 尾鳍轻轻相触，像打了个招呼。
lines.en: Their tail fins touch lightly, like a greeting.

lines.zh: 深水里，它们绕着彼此转圈。
lines.en: In the deep they circle slowly around each other.

lines.zh: 它把身体侧过去，鳞光一闪。
lines.en: It turns its flank, scales flashing once.

lines.zh: 同伴靠近时，它的尾摆得更缓。
lines.en: When its partner nears, its tail beats more slowly.

lines.zh: 两条鲨鱼并肩下潜，影子叠成一条。
lines.en: Two sharks dive abreast, shadows merging into one.

lines.zh: 它用吻部碰了碰对方的侧腹。
lines.en: It nudges the other's flank with its snout.

lines.zh: 它们在水层里绕成一个小小的环。
lines.en: They wind into a small ring in the water column.

lines.zh: 分开时，长尾还互相扫了一下。
lines.en: On parting, their long tails brush once more.

lines.zh: 鱼排沉下去，它看都不看。
lines.en: The fillet sinks and it does not even look.

lines.zh: 掉落的鳞片它一口吞了，随即吐掉。
lines.en: It gulps a fallen scale, then spits it out.

lines.zh: 它对水底的东西没兴趣，只认活物。
lines.en: It ignores the seabed and cares only for living prey.

lines.zh: 一块骨头落下来，被它尾巴扫开。
lines.en: A bone falls; its tail sweeps it aside.

lines.zh: 它绕着掉落物转一圈，又游走了。
lines.en: It circles the dropped item once, then leaves.

lines.zh: 你丢出的东西，它当成小石头。
lines.en: Whatever you throw, it takes for a pebble.

lines.zh: 它捡起一块贝壳，闻了闻就松口。
lines.en: It picks up a shell, sniffs, and lets it go.

lines.zh: 掉进水里的肉，它留给更小的鱼。
lines.en: Meat dropped in the water it leaves to smaller fish.

lines.zh: 它顶了顶那个物品，像在试探。
lines.en: It noses the item as if testing it.

lines.zh: 吞下的东西不合胃口，它又吐出来。
lines.en: What it swallows does not suit it, so it spits it back.

lines.zh: 我盯上一条中等大小的鱼。
lines.en: I fix on a fish of middling size.

lines.zh: 眼睛一转，我锁定了猎物。
lines.en: My eye flicks and the prey is chosen.

lines.zh: 深水里，一条鱼影被我圈住。
lines.en: In the deep I ring a single fish shadow.

lines.zh: 我开始压低头部，准备加速。
lines.en: I lower my head, preparing to accelerate.

lines.zh: 尾鳍一紧，我选好了目标。
lines.en: My tail fin tenses; the target is set.

lines.zh: 我绕到猎物背后，慢慢靠近。
lines.en: I swing behind the prey and close in slowly.

lines.zh: 那条小鱼还没察觉，已经被盯上。
lines.en: The little fish, unaware, is already marked.

lines.zh: 我选中了鱼群里落单的一只。
lines.en: I pick the one straggler of the shoal.

lines.zh: 我把身体对准猎物，尾摆加快。
lines.en: I aim my body at the prey, tail beating faster.

lines.zh: 四点伤害，足够对付这种猎物。
lines.en: Four points of damage are plenty for such prey.

lines.zh: 我贴着猎物后面，一步不放。
lines.en: I stay glued behind the prey, never letting go.

lines.zh: 长尾一摆，距离缩短了一截。
lines.en: One tail stroke closes the gap by a length.

lines.zh: 我压低身体，从下方斜插上去。
lines.en: I drop low and cut upward at an angle.

lines.zh: 猎物转向，我也立刻跟着转。
lines.en: The prey turns; I turn at the same instant.

lines.zh: 水被我劈开，气泡拖成一条线。
lines.en: Water parts around me, bubbles trailing in a line.

lines.zh: 我不叫，只用尾巴打水催自己。
lines.en: I make no sound, only beating my tail for speed.

lines.zh: 那条鱼往礁缝里钻，我追到缝口。
lines.en: The fish darts into a crevice; I follow to the mouth.

lines.zh: 我绕着猎物转，找最软的一侧。
lines.en: I circle the prey, hunting the softer flank.

lines.zh: 距离只剩半个身位，我张开了嘴。
lines.en: Half a body length away, I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 尾尖一拍，我猛地窜了出去。
lines.en: A flick of my tail tip and I lunge.

lines.zh: 长尾先抽过去，把猎物打晕。
lines.en: My long tail strikes first, stunning the prey.

lines.zh: 我一口咬住，四点伤害干脆利落。
lines.en: I bite down, four points of damage, clean and quick.

lines.zh: 尾巴像鞭子，啪地抽在水里。
lines.en: My tail cracks through the water like a whip.

lines.zh: 我撞开猎物，再补上一口。
lines.en: I knock the prey aside, then bite again.

lines.zh: 咬完我甩头，把猎物撕开。
lines.en: After the bite I shake my head, tearing the prey.

lines.zh: 血丝散开，我又补了一下。
lines.en: Blood threads the water and I strike once more.

lines.zh: 我用尾鳍拍水，把小鱼震得发懵。
lines.en: My tail fin slaps the water, dazing the small fish.

lines.zh: 那一口咬在鳃边，猎物挣了两下。
lines.en: The bite lands by the gills; the prey thrashes twice.

lines.zh: 我把猎物拖向深处，慢慢享用。
lines.en: I drag the catch deeper to feed at leisure.

lines.zh: 攻击时尾巴总是先到，牙齿后到。
lines.en: In every strike my tail arrives first, my teeth after.

lines.zh: 深温水海洋的暗处，它忽然出现。
lines.en: It appears suddenly in the gloom of the deep lukewarm ocean.

lines.zh: 深温带海洋里，一只长尾鲨独自游开。
lines.en: In the deep temperate ocean a lone thresher swims off.

lines.zh: 深温暖海洋的水层多了一道长影。
lines.en: A long shadow joins the deep warm ocean's water column.

lines.zh: 它总是单独出现，从不结队。
lines.en: It always arrives alone, never in company.

lines.zh: 刷怪蛋一碎，长尾先扫出一圈水纹。
lines.en: The spawn egg breaks; the long tail sweeps a ring of ripples.

lines.zh: 深水沉沉的，它就悬在那片黑里。
lines.en: The deep is heavy, and it hangs in that blackness.

lines.zh: 海床的沙被它尾巴掀起一小片。
lines.en: Its tail lifts a small patch of seabed sand.

lines.zh: 一只，就一只，从深处升上来。
lines.en: One, just one, rises from the depths.

lines.zh: 它出现时，附近的小鱼全散了。
lines.en: When it arrives, every small fish nearby scatters.

lines.zh: 深海的冷光落在它的长尾上。
lines.en: The deep sea's pale glow falls on its long tail.

lines.zh: 火焰在水里烧不旺，我却疼得乱窜。
lines.en: Fire barely burns underwater, yet I thrash in pain.

lines.zh: 被抛上岸，我长尾拍地，拼命想回水里。
lines.en: Beached, I slap the ground with my long tail, desperate for water.

lines.zh: 水里我本该自在，此刻鳃盖却急扇。
lines.en: Water is my home, yet now my gill covers flap wildly.

lines.zh: 冲击波推着我翻了个身，尾鳍乱摆。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over, tail fin flailing.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进背鳍，我扭头去咬箭杆。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my dorsal fin; I turn to bite the shaft.

lines.zh: 药水般的白光裹住我，长尾抽搐了一下。
lines.en: A potion-white light wraps me; my long tail twitches.

lines.zh: 饿久了，我连礁石缝里的小鱼都翻。
lines.en: Long hungry, I root even the crevices for small fish.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，整片海水都亮了一瞬。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and the whole sea flashes white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我的长尾徒劳地摆。
lines.en: There is no water in the void; my long tail beats in vain.
